title: Paul's merkabah conversion

tellings.quote: wanting Christians to die and then he has this merkaba situation that he seemingly didn't cultivate right it happened just spontaneously to him

plain: Diana Pasulka, a professor of religious studies, tells a podcast host, Jesse Michels, about the Apostle Paul, the early Christian leader. She says Paul at first wanted Christians to die, and then had a merkabah experience, a kind of overwhelming heavenly vision named after a chariot in Jewish mystical writing, which he did not seek but which simply happened to him. She tells it as an ancient example of a sudden encounter that changed a life, of the sort people now link to UFOs.
